description: This is a PHP unit test class named 'ModuleServiceTest' that tests the methods of the 'ModuleService' class related to module management within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It contains setup, test cases for retrieving the module DAO, fetching the module list, and updating module statuses.

classes.name: ModuleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ModuleService component related to module management in OrangeHRM. Utilizes setup and multiple test methods to validate DAO retrieval, list fetching, and status updating functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ModuleService before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getModuleDao() method returns an instance of ModuleDao.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests that getModuleList() returns the expected list of Module objects, using a mock DAO and fixture data.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Checks that updateModuleStatus() correctly updates modules and returns the expected list, mocking DAO behavior.
